Opt-Out Management 
Enabled
Deliver a customized, end-to-end compliance experience for your users. Set the opt-in, opt-out, and help keywords and messages on a global basis as well as add per-country and per-language overrides.
Standard Opt-Out Keywords
Edit

All of your recipients will get these opt-out responses unless you create responses for their specific spoken language or country code.

Opt-Out
Keywords: alto, cancel, end, optout, parar, quit, revoke, stop, stopall, unsubscribe
Message: Machines & Cloud: texts stopped. Reply START or EMPEZAR to remove the block.
Opt-In
Keywords: empezar, start, unstop
Message: Machines & Cloud: your texting block is removed. We only reply to messages you send; no recurring texts. Reply HELP for help or STOP to stop.
Help
Keywords: ayuda, help, info
Message: Machines & Cloud: account help at https://machinesandcloud.com/desk. Setup guidance at https://machinesandcloud.com/onboard. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to stop texts.
Language-Specific Opt-Out Keywords

Specify opt-out keywords and responses for the spoken languages of your messaging recipients.

Country Code Opt-Out Keywords

Specify opt-out keywords and responses for spoken language and country code combinations when the keywords and messages differ from country to country within the same language.
